description: Main entry point for a Flutter application that initializes Supabase and displays a minimal Todos list. Sets up app state, handles configuration errors, and fetches data from a 'todos' table.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget managing app initialization states and UI display, including placeholder, error, and main content screens.

classes.name: _InitErrorScreen
classes.description: Widget displaying detailed initialization error messages and guidance.

classes.name: TodosPage
classes.description: Stateful widget that fetches and displays a list of todos from the database.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Asynchronous main function initializes Flutter binding, validates Supabase config, initializes Supabase, and runs the app.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Widget build method in MyApp, determines which UI to display based on initialization state.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Widget build method in _InitErrorScreen, displays error details and instructions.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes state in TodosPage, starts fetching todos.

methods.name: _fetchTodos
methods.description: Performs an async fetch of todos data from the 'todos' table via Supabase client.
